an4.56:1.1: “Bhikkhus, if both husband and wife wish to behold one another not only in this present life but also in future lives, they should have the same faith, the same virtuous behavior, the same generosity, and the same wisdom. Then they will behold one another not only in this present life but also in future lives.”
an4.56:2.1: The verses are identical with those of AN4.55.
